items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer introduces Sven Abow as the engineer; Interviewee does not mention Sven Abow in any personal or professional capacity.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Eugene Holley with recording engineer Sven Aboe Institution Description: Transcript, 72 pp.

Okay, my name is Eugene Holley. I am here with engineer Sven Abow for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project at the home of Mr. Percy Leroy Heath Jr. in Montauk, Long Island on Monday, July the 23rd. Thank you Mr. Heath.
Two thousand and one, and you can believe that.
